{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMake build configuration, Guix build scripts, and package manifests (vcpkg.json) to eliminate the Boost.Test dependency across the build system.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes the Boost.Test external dependency across build scripts, depends, and Guix. While dropping the dependency reduces build-system workarounds, it is a straightforward dependency cleanup with modest direct impact on the build system itself compared to release integrity or toolchain breaks."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp only via a mechanical include replacement of Boost test headers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change does not touch IPC interfaces, serialization, or multiprocess architectures."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp mechanically to adopt the test framework header.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No kernel boundaries, APIs, or validation logic are modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an in-tree test runner and expression-decomposing assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} to replace Boost.Test.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework, resolving long-standing maintainability goals discussed in RFC #34666 and issue #8670. The new framework improves failure diagnostics via expression decomposition and eliminates platform-specific runtime issues like undersized signal stacks (#36045)."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes under contrib are confined to Guix build scripts (contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh), which belong to the build category.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect developer CLI tools, signet tools, or maintenance utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/wallet/test/ are mechanical updates to test headers and macro shims.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No wallet logic, transaction creation, or storage mechanics are changed."
    }
  ],
